rate_model_note: Flat amount per mainline plaza (A-E) and one amount for every toll ramp. 2-axle rates are the same at all hours; 3+ axle ExpressToll rates vary by hour and are not captured.
source_note: The page states no effective date. The 2-axle rates are identical in every archived copy checked (web.archive.org 2025-01-22, 2025-06-24, 2025-11-17, 2026-01-13) and on the live page 2026-11-06; E-470 changes rates on 1 January, so the card is dated 2025-01-01 - the earliest date the archive proves, not a published one.
payment_premium_note: License Plate Toll is what a vehicle without an ExpressToll account pays. A statement not paid by its due date adds a one-time $5 late fee (not estimated).
